frame.converter: Each sky position at a depth drawn from the spheroid's density along its sight line (frame.spheroid).

spheroid.basis: The spheroid the volume's light is spread through (src/objects/ngc-3311-volume/source/experiment.json shapePrior): Arnaboldi et al.'s (2012) Table 2 Sérsic fit to NGC 3311 (n = 4.8, half-light radius 198.8 arcsec, 52.3 kpc at 54.3 Mpc, axis ratio 0.93), axis along NGC 3311's minor axis in the plane of the sky, ending at 1.409 half-light radii, where the fit's field ends. Each object's depth is drawn from it, not measured.

meaning: Globular clusters and ultra-compact dwarf galaxies of the Hydra I Cluster's core that Misgeld et al.'s (2011) spectra place in the cluster by their velocities: one dot per object at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way globular clusters' warm orange.
